**Schedule:** Day shift (Includes rotational weekend shifts)

**About the Role**

A high-end multi-designer studio in Park Street is seeking a polished, personable **Fashion Consultant & Client Advisor** to join our in-store customer experience team.

In this position, you will act as a personal stylist and brand ambassador, guiding discerning shoppers through custom bridal wear, celebratory Indian couture, and modern ready-to-wear collections. If you have an eye for styling, an understanding of bespoke garments, and genuine passion for client engagement, this role provides an ideal platform to grow your fashion retail career.

**What You Will Do**

* **Curate Shopping Experiences:** Host walk-in visitors and private appointment clients, offering individualized wardrobe curation and styling guidance tailored to festive, wedding, and cocktail occasions.
* **Drive Conversions & Basket Value:** Present cohesive ensembles, introduce coordinating separates or statement accessories, and maximize daily sales targets through thoughtful cross-styling.
* **Master Product Stories:** Understand fabric compositions, artisanal hand-embroidery techniques (zardozi, thread work, sequins), garment fits, and care handling to convey brand craftsmanship to buyers.
* **Manage Fittings & Tailoring Coordination:** Conduct fitting sessions with finesse, take clear alteration notes, and interface directly with our in-house master tailors to guarantee flawless garment finish and delivery.
* **Floor Operations & Cash Desk:** Handle sales transactions, digital invoicing, point-of-sale software entries, and day-end payment balancing with accuracy.
* **Maintain Display Aesthetics:** Uphold boutique floor presentation, keeping garment racks organized, mannequins styled, and trial suites spotless throughout store hours.
* **Inventory Control:** Support stock intake, barcoding, cycle counts, and stockroom cleanliness.
* **Social & Visual Support:** Assist with quick in-house styling showcases, photo/video moments, and seasonal mood boards when needed.

**Candidate Profile**

* **Background:** 1 to 3+ years in luxury retail, designer studio clienteling, or premium apparel showroom sales.
* **Education:** Minimum Higher Secondary completed; diploma/degree in Fashion Styling, Garment Technology, or Retail Management is welcomed.
* **Soft Skills & Presence:** Impeccably groomed with strong social etiquette and active listening skills.
* **Languages:** Comfortable conversing in English and Hindi; conversational Bengali is a clear plus for engaging local clientele.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Basic working knowledge of computerized billing systems (POS) and inventory spreadsheets.

**What We Offer**

* Fixed monthly salary: ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 (commensurate with background and styling acumen)
* Direct sales commissions and monthly milestone bonuses
* In-house employee discount privileges on curated designer wear
* High-visibility exposure to prominent fashion designers, VIP guests, and bespoke styling workflows

**Supplemental Pay:**

* Commission pay
* Performance bonus

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Job Description: Salon / Studio Manager – Nail Story

**Job Title:** Salon / Studio Manager

**Brand:** Nail Story

**Locations:** Kolkata (Openings across 5 locations: Minto Park, City Centre 1 – Salt Lake, City Centre 2 – Rajarhat, Acropolis Mall, and Paanache Club)

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Industry:** Beauty, Wellness & Personal Care

Role Overview

Nail Story is looking for vibrant, organized, and customer-centric **Studio Managers** to lead day-to-day operations across our prime Kolkata branches.

As a Studio Manager, you will oversee boutique salon operations, manage a team of talented nail technicians and front-desk executives, drive retail and service sales, ensure impeccable hygiene standards, and deliver an elevated luxury experience to our clientele.

Key Responsibilities1. Daily Operations & Studio Management

* Oversee the end-to-end daily opening and closing procedures of the assigned studio.
* Monitor appointment books, walk-in allocations, and technician assignments to maximize chair utilization and minimize wait times.
* Maintain salon aesthetics, ambient lighting, music, and pristine hygiene/sanitization standards in compliance with brand guidelines.
* Handle petty cash, daily billing reconciliation, point-of-sale (POS) systems, and end-of-day revenue reporting.

2. Team Leadership & People Management

* Lead, mentor, and motivate salon staff, including nail artists, nail technicians, and housekeeping staff.
* Create weekly rosters, manage shift schedules, and approve leave requests without disrupting salon operations.
* Address internal staff grievances and maintain high morale and a professional code of conduct on the floor.
* Partner with the training and HR teams to coordinate upskilling sessions on the latest nail art techniques and product applications.

3. Client Relationship Management (CRM)

* Act as the primary brand ambassador on the floor, greeting high-profile clients and ensuring warm hospitality.
* Efficiently handle customer feedback, service adjustments, complaints, or escalations with tact and professionalism.
* Drive customer retention programs, membership packages, and repeat appointments via phone or WhatsApp follow-ups.

4. Inventory & Stock Control

* Supervise weekly and monthly stock audits for all consumables (gels, acrylics, polishes, tools, sanitizers) and retail merchandise.
* Raise timely purchase orders to avoid stock-outs during peak seasons and festival periods.
* Monitor product usage per service to minimize pilferage, leakage, or wastage.

5. Sales & Business Growth

* Meet and exceed monthly revenue targets for nail services, extensions, nail art, and retail aftercare products.
* Work closely with marketing to promote location-specific campaigns, seasonal discounts, and festival/bridal packages.

Requirements & Qualifications

* **Education:** Graduate in any discipline; certifications or diplomas in Salon Management, Hospitality, or Cosmetology are a strong plus.
* **Experience:** 2–5 years of proven experience as a Salon Manager, Assistant Manager, Floor Manager, or Front Office Executive in a premium nail salon, beauty parlor, spa, or luxury retail/hospitality outlet.
* **Skills:**
* Strong leadership, conflict resolution, and people management skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in English, Hindi, and Bengali.
* Working knowledge of POS software, salon scheduling tools, MS Excel, and digital payment systems.
* Understanding of nail care services, hygiene protocols, and nail enhancement trends.

Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive monthly salary based on experience.
* Performance-based monthly incentives and service commission targets.
* Paid annual leave, festival bonuses, and employee discounts on salon services.

Pay: From ₹15,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
